evidenceType: Forecasts retrospectively reproduced in the annual report; original release dates and contemporaneous input vintages are not yet archived
comparisonStatus: No matched Modelica forecast. These are benchmarks to beat at the same information cutoff, not proof of model superiority. Budget is a planning reference and must be evaluated separately from in-year forecasts.
definition: Signed error = forecast minus actual. Source table also contains rounded budget deviations; errors here are calculated from the displayed forecast and outcome, not copied from its deviation row.
